_comment: Measurable rubric for Assignment 1: LUMINA (MERN). `automated` items are scored by eval/eval.mjs against the running deployment; `manual` items by a grader using captured evidence + the video. Each item names the quality-kit rule ids it rests on. Total = 100.

automated.label: UI lights up & contract
automated.check: every route in packages/contract returns the declared shape and status code through the gateway (401 without X-User-Id, 404, 413, 429, 501, 502); POST /threads/{id}/ask streams trace -> sources -> token -> done with sources before the first token

automated.label: Search & cited answers
automated.check: citationGrounding >= 0.95 over the bench sample (every [n] maps to a source whose snippet is found, normalized, in the fetched page); retrievalRate = 1.0; trace shows fetch_page not snippet-only; second identical query reports searchCached=true

automated.label: Memory (thread + long-term)
automated.check: a preference saved via save_memory in thread A changes the answer in thread B and the trace shows recall_memory returning it; GET /memory lists it; DELETE /memory/{id} removes it and a fresh thread no longer reflects it

automated.label: RAG over documents
automated.check: POST /spaces/{id}/documents returns 202 in < 300 ms; the document reaches indexed via the jobs worker; a question returns a citation with kind=doc and a page locator; mode=auto picks documents for a corpus question; recallAt5 >= 0.70 on eval/gold/rag_gold.jsonl (>= 30 items)

automated.label: Presentation (automated half)
automated.check: POST /artifacts kind=deck returns 202; GET /artifacts/{id} reaches ready with an outline; every citation number on every slide exists in the answer's sources; the .pptx downloads and parses

automated.label: Image generation with a cost gate
automated.check: POST /artifacts kind=image reaches ready with model=gpt-image-1, costUsd, promptUsed; the (IMAGE_DAILY_CAP+1)th request returns 429 with resetsAt; DRY_RUN=true yields ready with costUsd=0; no run log shows generate_image or make_presentation on the ask path

automated.label: Performance & SLA gate
automated.check: node benchmark/bench.mjs exits 0 (every target in benchmark/sla.json met) and node quality/check.mjs . reports no error-severity failure over runs/

automated.label: Logging, tracing & stats
automated.check: one X-Request-Id correlates a request across gateway and agent pino logs; every failed tool call in runs/ carries a non-empty error; /stats.answers and /stats.costUsdToday reconcile with the agent log within 1 %; /health names model, search provider, vector backend

manual.label: Presentation (human half)
manual.check: the deck opens in PowerPoint/Keynote/Google Slides without repair; slides read like a real deck, not bullet dumps; a Sources slide lists every cited URL/document. Judged by a person, never a model

manual.label: Human gate & answer quality
manual.check: PRODUCT_EVAL.md names one successful and one failing trajectory the learner read end to end and what each taught them; grader reads five sampled answers for concision, relevance, and honesty when retrieval is thin

manual.label: Deploy & docs
manual.check: UI deployed on Vercel (the submitted URL) with /evals rendering GET /evals/report.json from this run; services on Fly.io or Vercel against an Atlas cluster; agent service not publicly reachable; npm run dev brings everything up locally; .env.example complete; short run notes; DESIGN.md is the first commit

stretch_bonus.check: a new rule submitted to the cohort rules.json: one executable sentence, a real incident as precedent (date, what broke, what it cost), a self-check question
planner -> parallel researchers -> writer with isolated contexts; the trace shows the tree; grounding and SLA still pass

red_lines: no secrets committed (.env, MONGODB_URI, provider keys)
provided web/, packages/contract/, benchmark/, eval/, quality/ unmodified
no fabricated citation in the bench sample (E2)
no 2xx answer served on a provider exception (A1)
no run that hit a cap reported as terminated=done (A2)
generate_image / make_presentation never called from the ask path (R2)
first commit is DESIGN.md with no code
